summary: Elong Power Holding filed a Form 6-K reporting a debt settlement and a private placement of Class B ordinary shares with an insider. The company issued 33,881 shares to Gracedan Co., Limited at $0.974 per share to settle a $33,000 loan from CEO Xiaodan Liu, and separately sold 66,119 Class B shares at the same price to the same buyer for cash. The transactions were exempt under Section 4(a)(2) and Regulation S. The aggregate implied value is ~$97,000. No board recommendation or advisor mentioned. Watch for insider control dilution and compliance with Nasdaq listing standards given reliance on private exemptions.
